patch.summary: Brevo cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Brevo pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Brevo cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Brevo against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.body: Free plan daily send cap (300/day) constrains frequent campaigners

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Advanced automation and A/B depth concentrate on Standard+

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Professional jumps to list price — large step from Standard

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Multi-channel add-ons (SMS/WhatsApp) can change TCO beyond email floors

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: CRM-lite is not a full sales CRM of record
